title: China’s GigaAI Seeks 2026 Hong Kong IPO in First for World Model
title_zh: 中国GigaAI寻求2026年香港IPO，成为世界典范
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Jijia Vision is in discussions to hold an initial public offering on Hong Kong’s stock exchange as soon as this year, joining a flurry of Chinese AI firms planning public market debuts.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——积家视觉正在讨论最快今年在香港证券交易所进行首次公开​​募股，加入众多计划公开市场的中国人工智能公司的行列。

title: US stocks edge down with Iran and earnings season in focus
title_zh: 美国股市小幅下跌，伊朗和财报季成为焦点
summary: STORY: Stocks started the week on a down note, with the Dow falling about six tenths of one percent, while the S&P 500 dropped two tenths and the Nasdaq ended basically flat.:: ArchiveInvestors looked for moves toward de-escalation in the Middle East while they waited for...
summary_zh: 故事：股市本周开局下跌，道琼斯指数下跌约十分之六百分之一，标准普尔 500 指数下跌十分之二，纳斯达克指数收盘基本持平。：档案投资者在等待...的同时，也在寻找中东局势缓和的举措。

title: Is the collectibles market in a bubble? Realest CEO says memorabilia is 'wildly undervalued'
title_zh: 收藏品市场是否存在泡沫？ Realest首席执行官表示纪念品“被严重低估”
summary: The Realest founder and CEO Scott Keeney joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss why high-end memorabilia remains "wildly undervalued" despite market bubble concerns.
summary_zh: The Realest 创始人兼首席执行官斯科特·基尼 (Scott Keeney) 与雅虎财经执行编辑布莱恩·索齐 (Brian Sozzi) 一起讨论了为什么尽管存在市场泡沫担忧，高端纪念品仍然“被严重低估”。

title: Trump Media pitches $100K-a-month Truth Social feed
title_zh: 特朗普媒体推出每月 10 万美元的真相社交信息流
summary: Scott Melker discusses Trump Media's proposal to charge institutional traders $100,000 a month for early access to Truth Social posts, warning that retail investors will likely get front-run and lose money trying to trade on the news.
summary_zh: 斯科特·梅尔克 (Scott Melker) 讨论了特朗普媒体 (Trump Media) 向机构交易员收取每月 10 万美元费用以让他们提前访问 Truth Social 帖子的提议，他警告说，散户投资者可能会抢先一步，并在尝试根据该消息进行交易时遭受损失。

title: US judge approves Anthropic's $1.5 billion settlement of copyright lawsuit
title_zh: 美国法官批准 Anthropic 15 亿美元版权诉讼和解
summary: By Blake Brittain July 20 (Reuters) - A federal judge in San Francisco on Monday signed off on artificial intelligence company Anthropic's landmark $1.5 billion settlement of a class action lawsuit
summary_zh: 作者：Blake Brittain 7 月 20 日（路透社）——周一，旧金山的一名联邦法官签署了人工智能公司 Anthropic 具有里程碑意义的 15 亿美元集体诉讼和解协议

title: AMD stock rises on price target bumps, Microsoft deal
title_zh: AMD 股价因目标价上涨和微软交易而上涨
summary: AMD stock rose more than 3% on Monday.
summary_zh: AMD 股价周一上涨超过 3%。

title: Why it's time to retire the 'Magnificent 7' name: Strategist
title_zh: 为什么是时候废除“华丽七人组”这个名字了：战略家
summary: It's time to retire the group name as the AI revolution creates new power players.
summary_zh: 随着人工智能革命创造出新的强者，是时候让这个团体的名字退役了。

title: Tech stocks live: Chip stocks recover from last week's losses on Google, AMD news
title_zh: 科技股活跃：芯片股从上周谷歌、AMD 消息的损失中恢复过来
